chapter: Regional bands, politics and travel abroad
title: Tiny Parham
summary: They joke about why Tiny Parham was so named and Hinton recalls his first trip away from home with him.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: And that reminds me of Tiny Parham, you remember him?
You know why they called him Tiny?
A giant of a man, yeah.
(Inaudible) most of his music had an Oriental flavor to it, Chu Chin Chow or --
He played that kind of thing, yeah.

My first trip away from home was with Tiny Parham. What a fabulous thing for us to rehash these days of our youth. These really, truly giants and pioneers. Chicago -- Don't you think Chicago was like the symbol of the United States at that time, the '20s and the '30s, all that jazz was going on there.
